title: A quoted empty key and a null key both match the empty pointer token, so the edit is ambiguous
notes: A pointer token matches a mapping key by the key's scalar text. The quoted key `""` has the empty text, and so does the explicit key `?` with no content (an empty node, section 7.2), which is null (section 8.2.2). The pointer `/` has the single empty token (RFC 6901 section 3), so it matches both keys. When two keys match a token the edit is refused and never guesses which one was meant; the document stays as it was.
